usdRate.sourceName: Eastern Caribbean Central Bank, exchange rates (US dollar)
usdRate.note: The EC dollar has been fixed at XCD 2.70 per US dollar since 1976.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: ECCB statistics, Consumer Price Index - Commonwealth of Dominica (Central Statistics Office data)
inflation_cpi.note: All-items index 121.85 in June 2026 against 120.77 in June 2025, a 0.9% year-on-year rise (computed from the published index); 2025 average inflation 0.91%. Latest published month is June 2026.

inflation_projection.sourceName: Dominica CPI: average inflation 3.0% a year over 2021-2025 (ECCB); EC dollar pegged to the US dollar
inflation_projection.note: With the EC dollar fixed to the US dollar, long-run inflation should track US inflation plus a little; 2.5% sits between the 2025 rate (0.9%) and the 2021-2025 average (3.0%).

policy_rate.sourceName: Eastern Caribbean Central Bank (ECCB), discount rate
policy_rate.note: The ECCB's discount rate was 3.00% on 31 October 2026; the EC dollar is pegged at 2.70 per US dollar, so the rate is a backstop rather than an active policy tool.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: ECCB, interest rates and weighted average rates on deposits, Dominica: savings deposits weighted average (EC dollars)
savings_account_rate.note: Weighted average rate on EC-dollar savings deposits 2.05% in June 2026; posted savings rates ranged 2.00-3.50% (August 2026), with the ECCB's 2% minimum savings rate as the floor.

fdr_3m_rate.note: The ECCB publishes no 3-month time-deposit rate for Dominica (shown as not available through August 2026).

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: ECCB, interest rates on deposits and loans, Dominica: 12-month time deposits, maximum posted rate (EC dollars)
fdr_1y_rate.note: Posted 12-month time-deposit rates ranged 0.25-1.50% in May-August 2026; the weighted average on all EC-dollar time deposits was 2.86% in June 2026, so negotiated or longer deposits pay more.

dps_rate.note: No monthly recurring deposit product with a published rate was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: ECCB, interest rates and weighted average rates on deposits, Dominica: total EC-dollar deposits weighted average
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Weighted average rate on all EC-dollar deposits 1.52% in June 2026 (all currencies 1.49%); World Bank deposit rate 1.54% (2025).

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found; government securities are sold through the regional securities market.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: ECCB/ECSE, weighted average interest rates on the Regional Government Securities Market, Dominica 91-day treasury bills
tbill_91d_rate.note: Dominica's July 2026 91-day treasury bill auction cleared at a 3.50% weighted average (2.38% average in 2025).

tbond_5y_rate.note: Dominica has issued no 5-year bonds on the regional market in 2021-2026; its last bond issues were 7-year bonds at 7.00% (August 2026).

tbond_10y_rate.note: Dominica has issued no 10-year bonds on the regional market in 2021-2026; its last bond issues were 7-year bonds at 7.00% (August 2026).

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: Inland Revenue Division, Dominica, current income tax rates
tax_bank_interest.note: Residents add interest to taxable income: the first XCD 30,000 is tax-free, then 15%, 25% and 35%. 15% is the first taxable band; there is no withholding for residents (15% withholding applies to non-residents).

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate exists for individuals.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: No deposit insurance scheme covering Dominican banks with a published cover limit was found.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap was found; the ECCB publishes only a 3-22% range for 'other lending rates' in Dominica.

equity_return_low.sourceName: No meaningful local stock market; global equity in EC dollars (pegged to USD); after-tax 91-day bill 3.5% x 0.85 = 3.0%
equity_return_low.note: Low case: global shares earn about the after-tax treasury bill rate.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Global equity index in EC dollars; after-tax 91-day bill 3.0% (ECCB RGSM)
equity_return_base.note: The regional exchange lists few shares, so equity is a global index in US-dollar terms (the EC dollar is pegged), 3.5 points above the after-tax bill rate.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Global equity long-run record in US dollars
equity_return_high.note: High case: global shares repeat their long-run record.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Gold USD 3,876/oz on 30 Oct 2026, 3% down in a year (Trading Economics); EC dollar pegged at 2.70
gold_return_low.note: Low case: gold flat in dollars, and so in EC dollars.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Gold USD price trend (Trading Economics); fixed EC dollar peg
gold_return_base.note: Base case: gold tracks long-run US inflation plus a little.

gold_return_high.note: High case: gold resumes its 2020s uptrend.

fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: posted one-year deposit rates after tax.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: EC-dollar time deposits weighted average 2.86% less 15% tax = 2.4% (ECCB)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: the average rate actually paid on time deposits, after tax.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: rolling government treasury bills.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: The Financial Services Unit publishes no claim settlement ratio for life insurers.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life cover is sold, but no regulator or non-company source of premiums by age was found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No regulator or non-company source of health insurance premiums by age was found.

oop_health_share.note: Out-of-pocket spending was 29.3% of current health expenditure in 2023 (latest available; older than 2025).

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Dominica CPI health index flat at 110.7 from mid-2025 to mid-2026 and lower than in 2022 (ECCB)
goal_inflation_health.note: Measured health prices have barely moved, but imported medical care tends to rise faster than general prices; planning uses 3%.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Dominica CPI education index 103.5 (2021) to 118.6 (June 2026), about 3% a year (ECCB)
goal_inflation_education.note: Education prices rose about 3% a year over 2021-2026, mostly in one 2024 jump; planning uses 3.5%.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects via georank.org
life_table_remaining.note: Remaining years derived from the 'life expectancy by current age' table for 2026 (UN WPP).

support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio of 19.1 in 2025. No UN WPP projection for 2040 or 2065 could be read for Dominica.

retirement_age_default.note: Pensionable age has been 65 since 2021; an age pension can be taken from 60, reduced by 0.5% for each month before 65.

retirement_age_government.note: The retirement age for public servants under the Pensions Act was not found; government workers also draw the social security age pension at 65.

retirement_return_low.note: Low case: posted one-year deposits after tax.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: EC-dollar time deposits weighted average 2.86% less 15% tax (ECCB)
retirement_return_base.note: Base case: time deposits and treasury bills, no higher than the 3.0% after-tax bill rate.

retirement_return_high.note: High case: rolling government treasury bills.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix of deposits, bills and global equity.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: roughly half safe EC-dollar fixed income and half global equity.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Equity high 9%; treasury bills 3.0% after tax

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No current non-contributory old-age pension amount was found; Dominica Social Security pays only contributory age benefits, and needy older people rely on public assistance from the social welfare division.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No non-contributory old-age pension rules were found.

gratuity_rule.note: No general statutory gratuity was found. Severance (redundancy benefit) under the Protection of Employment Act is paid only on redundancy after at least 3 years of service, through the Dominica Social Security Redundancy Fund.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Dominica Social Security, retirement age and benefits
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory social security for employees and the self-employed: age pension at 65 with at least 500 weekly credits (reduced pension from 60); 50-499 credits give a lump-sum age grant. The DSS pages state no automatic inflation indexation.

fdr_3m.note: Banks take short fixed deposits, but no 3-month rate is reported to the ECCB for Dominica.

dps.note: No monthly recurring deposit product was confirmed.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No retail savings bond for individuals was found.

tbill_91d.note: Individuals can bid through licensed intermediaries of the Eastern Caribbean Securities Exchange.

tbond_5y.note: Dominica has issued 7-year bonds (7.00% in August 2026) but no 5-year bonds since 2021.

equity_fund.note: No locally regulated diversified retail equity fund was identified; the regional stock exchange lists few companies.

gold.note: No local market for investment gold bars or coins was identified.

insuranceRegulator.name: Financial Services Unit (FSU), Ministry of Finance

publicHealthCover.name: Ministry of Health (public hospitals and health centres)
